propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 section before Phase 1 that searches the tracker for existing duplicate reports and establishes the reported-against version floor

The skill must record either 'no existing ticket found' or create a duplicates link to resume an existing ticket, including closed tickets (759 of 764 bugs are closed, so open-only sweep is incomplete)

The reported-against version must be derived from either explicit rebar/commit/tag version in the report text, or computed from the ticket's created_at nanosecond field via git rev-list --before="@$(( created_at / 1000000000 ))" origin/main to obtain a floor sha

The skill must explicitly state the nanosecond-to-seconds conversion and avoid passing raw nanoseconds to git --before=, which silently misinterprets them as far-future unix seconds and returns the tip
The skill must record 'reported-against version unknown' explicitly when neither source is available, rather than silently assuming main
The Step-0 duplicates link action must be added to the approval-gate carve-out list (pre-approved project tracker writebacks) so the same file does not gate a mandatory action behind user approval
